title: Bopcal Dual Voltage 1.5in Heated Ionic Round Brush, Strawberry

comparisons.notes: Bopcal Dual Voltage Thermal Brush MS-C257 (1.5in), sale price 9.99 (reg 9.99), in stock on brand site
Exact same listing title as Woot's In the Box (1.5in, 6 temps 250-430F, ionic ceramic, dual voltage), pink finish, in stock

writeup: Woot has the Bopcal dual-voltage 1.5-inch heated round brush in Strawberry for $40.99, new, versus $89.99 on sale at Bopcal's own site. It has six heat settings from 250 to 430 degrees, a keratin-coated ceramic barrel with negative ions, about a 35-second heat-up, and 100-240V dual voltage for travel. Limit 3 per customer and stock looked very low.
